name: St. Anton
kurzbeschreibung:
**St. Anton in Tirol** – a world-famous ski and summer resort nestled in the heart of the **Lechtal Alps**, just a short drive from **Innsbruck**. Whether you're shredding the slopes, hiking through pristine alpine meadows, or indulging in hearty **Tiroler Gröstl** and **Kaiserschmarrn**, this village offers endless adventure and relaxation.

With its legendary **Arlberg Ski Area**, **St. Anton** is a mecca for winter sports, while summer brings thrilling mountain biking, paragliding, and breathtaking views of the **Verdoner Ferner** glacier. The charming old town, lively après-ski scene, and world-class cuisine make it a year-round destination for travelers seeking both adrenaline and tranquility.

Explore the **Zillertal Arena** for top-tier skiing, or unwind in a cozy **Hütte** with a glass of local **Apfelstrudel** and a view of the snow-capped peaks. **St. Anton**—where tradition meets thrill, and every season has its own magic.
